description:
Previously known as Flight Club, we're back for another hackathon - this time, we're taking things beyond the atmosphere

We're a duo who enjoy building creative projects, solving interesting problems, and occasionally turning questionable ideas into something that actually works

We bring curiosity, creativity, and technical skills, with an appreciation for last-minute breakthroughs

We're not recruiting, but we're happy to meet fellow space enthusiasts.

One flight to rule them all
